Learning with confidence

The right tools for learning.

Textbooks, learning materials and better equipment for the team.

02

The need

Identified needs include textbooks, teaching materials, a reading collection and office equipment. Continuing teacher training is also a priority.

The proposed response

Check existing stock and specifications before purchasing or accepting equipment. Match resources to the curriculum, ages and available power supply.

Next steps

  1. 01

    Inventory existing books and equipment

  2. 02

    Agree needs with the teachers

  3. 03

    Equip, train and monitor use

Who will benefit?

The Beog-Zaadba school community. Scope and beneficiary numbers will be approved for each stage before launch.
